caption: The drawing depicts a pair of metallic objects positioned symmetrically near the center of a plain, off-white background. Each object consists of two large circular loops, one at the top and one at the bottom, connected by an elongated, curved vertical piece. The two pieces are connected at the upper center by a single, wavy horizontal bar. The left object features some ornate, engraved or embossed detailing near the upper loop, including circular and triangular patterns, with accents that appear silver or light gray compared to the otherwise darker bronze or brownish metal. The right object is simpler, with no visible engraved patterns, and is similar in color to the left side, primarily showcasing a bronze or brown metallic tone. Beneath the objects, centrally aligned toward the bottom of the page, the drawing is signed with the names "Arthur F. Reynolds" and "Harry M. Waddell" in small, neat, black text. The composition is centered and isolated, with ample negative space surrounding the objects.
title: Bit
